content.short: Cross-chain USDC transfers and swaps built on Circle's native burn-and-mint rails.
content.description: Cashmere, incubated by Binance Labs, moves USDC between chains using Circle's Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol, so funds are burned on one network and minted natively on another rather than wrapped. It now describes itself as autonomous monetary infrastructure and is a 2026 Circle grantee. Its contracts are active on networks including Unichain and World Chain.
content.meta: Move USDC natively between chains with Cashmere, built on Circle's CCTP and incubated by Binance Labs.
